mechanism_family: market-neutral relative value (dollar-neutral + beta-neutral cross-sectional long/short)
lineage: NEW. Not EXP-ARP-008 (single-asset time-series rule). Not EXP-ARP-016/017/021 (long-only cross-sectional ranking, beta-exposed). The materially different object is a two-sided, dollar- and beta-neutralised book, whose return is a relative-value spread rather than crypto beta.
mechanism_statement: Rank the PIT eligible universe by a frozen cross-sectional reversal score, go long the cheapest top_k and short the richest bottom_k with equal notional per leg (sum of weights = 0) and a beta-neutrality overlay; the traded object is the neutral relative-value spread, not a directional exposure.

neutrality.dollar_neutral: long leg notional == short leg notional; sum of weights = 0
neutrality.beta_estimator: through-origin OLS slope of held-name daily returns on BTCUSDT daily returns
neutrality.fail_closed_if: |beta_book| > beta_tolerance -> no rebalance taken; book flat for that period

rules.signal: score_i = -log(close_i,t / close_i,t-30); rank eligible names by score descending
rules.entry: long top_k by score; short bottom_k by score; equal notional per leg
rules.exit: a name leaves when it drops out of its tail at a rebalance or after max_hold_days; act next open
rules.rebalance: every 7 days at UTC close; act next open
rules.stop: none (tail rotation plus the beta-neutrality fail-closed rule are the exits)
rules.position: two-sided neutral book; gross 2.0 x 500 USD = 1000 USD; no compounding; no net directional position

robustness_grid.note: pre-registered so the frozen choice cannot be read as cherry-picked; the frozen configuration is formation_days=30, top_k=10

short_leg.data_status: DATA_BLOCKED_INTERNAL — no funding-rate / borrow-rate / basis series exists in the 1d USDT corpus

spec_contract.entry_rule: long top_k / short bottom_k of the frozen reversal score, equal notional per leg (sum of weights = 0), act next open
spec_contract.exit_rule: exit a name when it leaves its tail or after max_hold_days, act next open; beta-neutrality fail-closed may take the book flat

implementation_config.entry_rule: long top_k / short bottom_k of the frozen reversal score, equal notional per leg (sum of weights = 0), act next open
implementation_config.exit_rule: exit a name when it leaves its tail or after max_hold_days, act next open; beta-neutrality fail-closed may take the book flat
implementation_config.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — pre-registration only; blocked pending short-leg borrow/funding data; no DEV execution in this phase

baselines: naive dollar-neutral BTC/ETH 1:1 pair, no ranking
long-only top_k of the same score (isolates the short-leg contribution)

power_requirement.note: effective sample is the binding constraint (ARP-012 §30); block-bootstrap CI on episodes is mandatory

kill_criteria: DEV net <= 0 after two-leg cost AND borrow -> REJECT_COSTS
DEV independent rebalances < 40 or VALIDATION < 15 -> REJECT_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE
single name/trade > 50% of positive DEV net or one period > 60% -> REJECT_FRAGILE
any look-ahead in score, beta window or fills -> REJECT_PIT
precondition: any promotable result without an observed borrow/funding series -> REJECT_SHORT_LEG_UNCOSTED

gates.promotion: positive net DEV AND positive net VALIDATION AND two-leg cost PASS AND borrow observed AND robustness PASS AND PIT PASS AND contract PASS AND sample sufficient AND |beta_book| consistent with 0 AND concentration acceptable AND builder != verifier
